releases.body:
### FIXES

- **A compression block that removed the head of the history no longer produces a request that starts mid-tool-loop.** The summary is injected at its anchor, which can sit well after the removed messages, so when the block covered the original prompt the outgoing history began with an `assistant` turn holding a `tool_use` and no user turn before it — Anthropic rejects that with `tool_use` ids were found without `tool_result` blocks immediately after, and the stored block re-applied on every later request, so the session kept failing. The first injected summary is now hoisted to the front whenever the original history started with a user turn; if there is no summary to hoist, the request goes out uncompressed rather than malformed.

Reported and fixed by [@leandromqrs](https://github.com/leandromqrs) in #14.

**Verification:** 440 tests / 137 suites passing, `tsc --noEmit` clean. Published to npm as `@serkanalgur/opencodev2-slim@3.2.1`.

## Initial Release

### Features
- TUI Panel with real-time context usage visualization
- Enhanced compress tool with auto/range/topic modes
- Semantic compression with intelligent grouping
- Cost-aware pruning based on token pricing
- Adaptive thresholds that learn from history
- Session persistence across restarts
- Deduplication and error purging
- Topic extraction and smart recommendations
- v2-only plugin (keymap.registerLayer API)

### Installation
```bash
opencode plugin @serkanalgur/opencodev2-slim@latest --global
```
